messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
目前網球排名會每週更新，以下列出截至我最後一次更新（2023‑12）時的兩大主要聯盟（ATP 與 WTA）首位選手，供您參考：

| 聯盟 | 首位選手 | 主要成就（截至 2023‑12） |
|------|----------|---------------------------|
| **ATP（男子）** | **Novak Djokovic** | 23 次大滿貫冠軍、世界排名歷史最高 3100 週、2023 年澳洲網球公開賽冠軍 |
| **WTA（女子）** | **Iga Świątek** | 3 次大滿貫冠軍、2023 年法網冠軍、世界排名歷史最高 1 週 |

> **注意**  
> - ATP 和 WTA 的排名每週一（或週二）更新一次，具體時間取決於各聯盟的官方公告。  
> - 若您需要最新的即時排名，建議直接查閱官方網站：  
>   - ATP 官方排名頁面：<https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles>  
>   - WTA 官方排名頁面：<https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles>  

如果您想知道某個特定年份或聯盟的排名，請告訴我，我可以為您提供更精確的資訊。

That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual ranking. We can answer based on knowledge: For men's tennis ATP ranking, as of 2026? Actually current year 2026. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can approximate: As of 2023, Novak Djokovic was top. But 2026 unknown. We might say "I don't have real-time data." But we can provide general answer: "As of my last update, the top-ranked ATP player is Novak Djokovic." For women's WTA: Iga Świątek. But question is singular: "目前排名第一的網球選手" ambiguous gender. Could answer both. Provide note that rankings change weekly. So answer accordingly.
